WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
), above_overall AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, o.avg_ratio,
           p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
), group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM above_overall
), final_patients AS (
    SELECT a.ratio, a.above_overall,
           a.ratio - g.avg_ratio AS above_group
    FROM above_overall a
    CROSS JOIN group_average g
    WHERE a.ratio > g.avg_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS avg_amount_above_overall_average,
       AVG(above_group) AS avg_amount_above_group_average
FROM final_patients
